sense.text:
“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” These pastors are wicked as hell. They are about nothing but money; they support wickedness, they support the fake Israelis, and they support the falsehood called democracy.

The sheep of God’s pasture are the house of Israel, the 12 tribes, and so when the pastors talk about God gathering his sheep and mean Baptists, Catholics, Episcopalians and Anglicans, they have it all wrong.

“Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away”. The pastors scattered God’s flock with their sins: one pastor is Baptist and takes a group of our people, another is African Methodist Episcopal and takes another group, and black Catholic pastors take another. That is how they scattered the flock, and they drove them away from the knowledge of the one true God, the Most High.

“Behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings”.

“I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them”. The flock of God is scattered in all countries, from the time of the Assyrians, Babylonians, Persians and Medes, Greeks and Romans, to Spain, France, England and now America, and God himself drove them there.

“And will bring them again to their folds”: back to their tribes, “and they shall be fruitful and increase.”

“I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them”. Not grits and honey, not pork chops and chitlins: they feed them with knowledge and understanding, which is God’s laws. Then “they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking”. We will not lack anything.

“I will raise unto David a righteous Branch”. That righteous Branch of David is Christ, whom the world calls Jesus the Christ, the anointed. He is our King, he shall reign and prosper, and he “shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.”

This is how you know the white man does not want Christ to come back: he has never executed justice in his life, because if he did he would have to start with himself. Our people in the churches say they want justice, but they want a soft-spoken Jesus who gives the white man a pass. Christ will execute judgment and justice in all the earth, and the Arabs, who stole all of North Africa and raped, robbed and pillaged, are going to get it too.

“In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely”. It does not say everybody on the planet is saved, not the Baptist religion, not the Catholics: Judah shall be saved. Judah and Israel are named separately because we were split into two kingdoms, the southern kingdom of Judah and the northern kingdom of Israel.

And his name is “THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.”

There is coming a day, when Christ returns, that we will no longer talk about how God brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand. We will say he led “the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country”, and the north country is North America, “and from all countries”.

“And they shall dwell in their own land.” Our people say Jamaica, Haiti, Puerto Rico; no, our own land is Jerusalem, the land they are fighting over right now.

“Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets”: those pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of God’s pasture, which goes back to verses one through four. Jeremiah was like a drunken man, drunk with reading the destruction and tribulation that would come upon us, and also our deliverance, “because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.”

“For the land is full of adulterers”: our land, filled with these pastors. Because of false swearing the land mourns, and “the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up”, which is why it looks like a desert over there. The course of our people is evil, and our force is not right.

“For both prophet and priest are profane”. In the Bible, profane is treating sacred things with irreverence and contempt, treating what is holy as common or unclean, defiling and polluting God’s name, his Sabbath and his sanctuary. Our people treat what is holy as common, like it is nothing.

“Yea, in my house have I found their wickedness”: in the temple itself.

“Their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness”. We would slip and slide in darkness with no sure foundation. God prophesied through Jeremiah that he would bring evil upon the 12 tribes of Israel because of these wicked pastors, “even the year of their visitation”.
“I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria”: even among the northern kingdom, the Latino tribes, God saw great sin. They prophesied in Baal, “and caused my people Israel to err.”

In the prophets of Jerusalem God saw “an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies”. The whole church system of Christianity is lies: Jesus born December 25th, Jesus a white man, Mary the ever virgin who never had other children. All of that is lies.

“They strengthen also the hands of evildoers”: the white man can do no wrong in their eyes, and they strengthen his hand. All of Christianity and all these lying pastors are unto God “as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.”

precepts.why:
Christ said, “I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” So the sheep of God’s pasture are the house of Israel.

The sheep are not all nations on the planet. The sheep is not the white man, not the Arab man, not the Chinese man. The only sheep are the 12 tribes of Israel, and those are the sheep the pastors of Jeremiah 23 have destroyed and scattered.

God promised, “I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.” That is what the shepherds of Jeremiah 23:4 feed the flock with: not food for the belly, but knowledge and understanding.

“For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth”. There is the word knowledge again, and here it is broken down: God’s knowledge is his law.

So the shepherds God sets up over the remnant of his flock feed them with knowledge, and that knowledge is God’s laws.

This is what justice is for the so-called white man, who had a big part in our enslavement and destruction: “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword.” The white man led us into captivity, and he killed millions upon millions of us with the sword. “Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

Ask our people in the Baptist, Mormon and Episcopal congregations whether they want justice and they say yes; read them Revelation 13:10 and they say no, no, no. Nobody wants Jesus justice. They want a soft-spoken Jesus who gives the white man a pass.

They say there are some good white folks. But Daniel, Mishael, Azariah and Hananiah went into slavery; Ezekiel went into captivity; Mordecai and Esther were in captivity; and they were righteous. If the righteous of Israel went into captivity, even the ones you think are good are going into captivity. That is the justice Christ executes in the earth.

“For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.” We all have to be mindful of that covetous spirit, and especially among the prophets, the pastors and the shepherds. All these pastors deal falsely.

“The heads thereof judge for reward”: the heads of our people, the leaders, judge for payback; they want money. “And the priests thereof teach for hire”, which is how they get their theology degrees, “and the prophets thereof divine for money”: they give you a word of knowledge, and you have to pay them.

“Yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.” They say it because of all the money they have accumulated. These shepherds are evil men, and now evil women too, because women pastors were unheard of. The only time you heard of women pastors was in the worship of false gods like Diana; that is why Paul told the women to keep silence in the churches, because those women came from worshipping Diana, where the women were the mouthpiece.

“Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps”. Because of these pastors, Zion, our country, was plowed as a field.

“Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty”. The possessors that slay us are the white man; you have no chains on your neck, so you think you are free, but you are not. In many of these cases the white men who killed our brothers and sisters were found not guilty, not all of them, but a large majority.

“They that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich”. That is the white man that sold us: he took the covenant of God in his mouth and called himself Christian and Jew, and through the selling of blacks and Latinos he became rich.

“And their own shepherds pity them not.” Our own leaders, our own pastors, do not care about us. The black church says it stands for righteousness, for holiness, for the word of God, and it is a lie. A white preacher says 90 to 95 percent of the black church in America is heretical and that black churches should be split up and sent to good God-fearing white churches to hear the real gospel. That is the white man’s solution, and the black apologists agree with him; none of them make videos against that kind of rhetoric.

If the black church stood for the truth in the Bible, the first thing it would know is who the true church is. Moses, who said “A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear”, was “in the church in the wilderness”. The church in the wilderness was the 12 tribes of Israel, not the Baptist church, not the Catholic or Protestant church. When the Bible uses the word church it is talking about the assembly of the 12 tribes of Israel, the same sheep of God’s pasture.

If the black church stood for righteousness, organized and called for justice, the FBI would have harassed it and shut it down like every other black political or revolutionary group that stood up for black and brown people, and the Anti-Defamation League, the Southern Poverty Law Center and Canary Mission, the arm of white supremacy, would have run a slander campaign against it. But the black church stands for nothing except feed me. All the pastors care about is money.

sense.text: “Truly God is good to Israel”: to the 12 tribes of Israel, “even to such as are of a clean heart”, those that walk in righteousness and do what the Bible says, the commandments.

“My steps had well nigh slipped.” That is what we read in Jeremiah 23 about the pastors slipping in their foolishness. The prophet Asaph says, “I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.” Some of us get envious when we see the prosperity of the wicked.

You see Esau prospering wherever he goes; whatever he touches seems to turn to gold. Our people see the top ten billionaires, Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, Bernard Arnault, Mark Zuckerberg, Larry Ellison, Larry Page, Sergey Brin, Warren Buffett, Bill Gates, Steve Ballmer, and they get envious. So many of us bought into getting rich or dying trying.

“There are no bands in their death”: bands means sufferings, there is no suffering in their death, “but their strength is firm.” You wonder why he does all this evil on the planet and does not have problems like the rest of us. They grow old because a lot of times they are living off stolen organs. They do not just steal land and people; they steal organs, and the brother who marks organ donor on his license goes in for an ear infection and comes out dead. That is most likely what happened to Kendrick Johnson, whose body was found with the organs missing.

“They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.” These elite whites with all this wealth are not like everybody else.

“Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain”: they have so much wealth that pride covers them like a chain. “Violence covereth them as a garment”: a lot of them have old slave money invested in war companies, weaponry and military things. Violence covers this white man like a garment; he has slaughtered our people and could care less, and the black and Latino Christians could care less too.

“They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.” They do not care about our slavery. Trump says take Martin Luther King’s name off the parks, take slavery out of the schools so white children do not feel bad, no critical race theory, get rid of DEI, we owe them nothing, I am not apologizing for slavery; we did it, so what? And now they open the FBI files to besmirch Martin Luther King because black people look up to him, and black Christians join in the song and dance.

Europeans have traumatized every continent, and the trauma this white man has caused has multiplied from way back until now. They let the cat out of the bag; they want it known.

“They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.” “Waters of a full cup are wrung out to them”: they give their own people the last drop, and you and me nothing. “And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?” If there is a God, does he even know?

“Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.” The ungodly are these white folks, and some negroes and Latinos follow right behind them. Mark Zuckerberg stole Facebook from the college students who hired him to build it.

Asaph says he cleansed his heart in vain, “For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.” “When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me”: too painful even to know it.

“Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.” A lot of times we envy people and do not know how they got their money. Somebody might have died and left it to them, but nine times out of ten, especially with white folks, it came through criminality: the so-called Jews, Italians and Irish running the mob, and then the police force and the fire department handed out to their ethnic groups. Only by reading and understanding the word of God will you understand their end.

“Surely thou didst set them in slippery places”: God set this white man in a slippery place, a position to fall, and “castedst them down into destruction.” Asaph saw a vision of it. “How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment!” That moment is one hour; that is the destruction. “They are utterly consumed with terrors.”

“As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest”: when the Lord wakes from the slumber and starts to execute judgment in the earth, “thou shalt despise their image.”

Their image is the image of Caesar Borgia. That image of the fake Jesus represents all Edom. God is not sleeping; he is watching everything, but he is being quiet, and when he awakes, meaning when he starts intervening, he will make a grand entrance.

precepts.why:
“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”. If you do not know who the wicked is, find him by process of elimination. It is not the black man and the Latin man; we are not ruling anything, we cannot even rule our own homes. The white man rules supreme on this planet; whatever you want done in your country, you have to go through him.

“He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. The judges are God, Christ, the angels and the Israelites, and it is the white man who covers their faces: he shows you a black Mary holding a black baby Christ, and somehow, shazam, that baby grows up into a white man, and nobody sees anything wrong with it.

“And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” That is the Dark Ages: God made Esau poverty-stricken. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return”: that is the Renaissance, when they returned, conquered us and made us their slaves, Christian slaves.

“And build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”. God gave them a chance to build, and they built up America, England, France, Germany and Australia from everything they robbed and pillaged.

“They shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Indignation is righteous anger. So it identifies who the wicked of Psalm 73 is: Esau, Edom.

David says, “Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man”. This is about the white man, the man Psalm 73 says violence covers as a garment. He imagines mischiefs in his heart, and “continually are they gathered together for war.” If there is no war, bet your last dollar the white man will start one. He can never let there be peace on earth, goodwill toward men; the way God made him, in his nature, he is a violent man.

“They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.” Selah means it is true. Whatever comes out of their mouth, their philosophies, their religions, their politics, which is a religion to some of them, is the worst kind of poison: take hold of it and you die.

“Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.” The wicked of Job 9:24 and Malachi 1:4 is the violent man too, and his purpose on earth is to overthrow the 12 tribes of Israel. They cannot rest when they see one of us with a nice car or a nice home; he has to be selling drugs.

“The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me.” The cords, the net and the gins are traps: their traps of religion and politics. The violent man kidnapped Maduro with new weaponry that shut down his military in minutes; the US bombed seven countries in 2025 under Trump, and dropped 26,171 bombs on seven countries in 2016 under Obama. This is the violent man, and this is the time we are living in.

“Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?” Wicked balances are unjust judgments. “For the rich men thereof are full of violence”: these rich people come from old money, gotten through the rape, robbery and pillaging of our nations and our peoples.

“And the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.” Their descendants justify the evil of their forefathers, not all of them but a lot of them. They are quick to say it was not me, it was my ancestors, while they enjoy what their ancestors did. They will say anything to justify it because they benefit from it. These are the ungodly who “increase in riches.”

The image God shall despise is the image of the beast. He “deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”. Those miracles are his science and technology, the atom bomb and the hydrogen bomb he dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, in the sight of the beast with seven heads and ten horns: the European powers, Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Britain, and the ten horns all present in World War II.

“Saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.” The one that had the wound by a sword was Rome, so the image must come from Rome. It is the Sallman head that servicemen carried in their wallets in World War II, and it goes back to the sketches Leonardo da Vinci made of Caesar Borgia, son of Pope Alexander, as the new Renaissance Jesus. Esau’s own book, In the Pillory by John Bond, calls it an open secret that Caesar Borgia posed for the bust of the Savior. The elders taught this long before that book was found, and Rocky Stone, the one Edomite who went to the library and checked it, came back and told our people that white Jesus is not the Jesus of the Bible.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” They gave Caesar Borgia’s image the life of Christ; it lives in their church system and their movies, where actors who look like him speak the words of the Bible and our people cry that it is Jesus. And when they conquered, whoever would not worship their white god was put to death.

That is the image of Psalm 73:20. It represents all Edom, and when God awakes, he shall despise it.

sense.text:
Esau has an Achilles heel. Achilles, the greatest Greek warrior of the Trojan War, could only be killed through his heel, his single vulnerability; and the prophecy of Esau’s weakness starts here.

Rebekah was barren; they tried and tried, and “the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.”
“And the children struggled together within her”: children, more than one, struggling in her womb. If I am blessed of God, why am I having trouble in my belly? So she went to ask God about it.

“Two nations are in thy womb”: this is the origin, the beginning, of two nations. “Two manner of people”: two manner means two different types. “The one people shall be stronger than the other people”, able to endure great hardships, strong mentally and physically, “and the elder shall serve the younger.” The elder is destined to serve the younger; that is a prophecy.

The twins were not identical, because verse 23 already said two manner of people. “The first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” He is not white; there is no white man on the earth, that is just what we were forced to call him. White means pure and holy, and they are not pure and sure are not holy.

Esau means wasted away; it does not mean hairy. Seir, where he dwelt in mount Seir, means hair, because the mountains were steep like straight hairs.

“His hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob”. Notice it does not give the color of Jacob at all. We want to highlight that he took hold on Esau’s heel: that is Edom’s Achilles heel.

Esau grew up a cunning hunter, a man of the field, and Jacob “a plain man, dwelling in tents.” Isaac loved Esau because he ate of the venison he hunted, but Rebekah loved Jacob, because she understood the prophecy.

Esau said, “Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage”: pottage with uncooked meat in it, and he wanted it raw, the same way he orders his steak rare today and eats steak tartare. “Therefore was his name called Edom.” Edom means red. So Esau means wasted away, Seir means hair, and Edom means red, and Esau is called both Esau and Edom in the Bible. Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom.

Remember Jacob took hold on Esau’s heel, and remember the prophecy in the garden before they were put out. “I will put enmity”: God put hatred “between thee and the woman”, thee being Satan and Cain’s people, and the woman being her descendants that would come through her, which is Israel.

“And between thy seed and her seed”. Satan has seed on this earth, and when Genesis 3:15 was spoken, Cain was not yet born: the seed of Satan was Cain. Her seed is Israel.

“It shall bruise thy head”: our head is Christ; smite the shepherd and the sheep shall scatter. “And thou shalt bruise his heel”: that is what we want to touch on. It is spoken to the woman, and it comes through her seed: Christ shall bruise his heel. That is the heel of Esau that Jacob took hold on, Edom’s Achilles heel, and it is where the stone of Daniel 2 strikes.

precepts.why: “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” If Cain obeyed, he would be accepted. “And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” That thee is Satan: Cain’s desire would be unto Satan, and Satan would rule over him. Satan would be Cain’s god and Cain’s father. That is the seed of the serpent of Genesis 3:15.

“Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth”. What is wrong with that? Abel was already killed, so why does it never say Cain was in Adam’s image? Seth was in Adam’s image; Cain was not.

“Let us make man in our image, after our likeness”. Adam, the black man, was made in the image of God. Then Adam and Eve had Cain and Abel, and Cain killed Abel, because he chose not to obey and Satan ruled over him. Everybody was supposed to be in the image of God, but Cain was not.

Whose image is Cain in? “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”. There are children of God on the planet and children of the devil on the planet. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.”

“Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother.” Cain was not of Adam; Seth was of Adam. Cain was of Satan, which is what we read in Genesis 4, and he slew Abel “Because his own works were evil”. That is the enmity between the two seeds.

Another precept: “Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”. His coming is after the working of Satan, meaning Satan is his father.

Cain’s line died in the flood, but all spirits return. Cain came back as Esau, and Abel came back as Jacob, or better, Seth came back. So the seed of the serpent and the seed of the woman of Genesis 3:15 came back as the twins struggling in Rebekah’s womb, and Jacob took hold on Esau’s heel.

sense.text: “This image’s head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver”: the arms of silver are Persia and Media. “His belly and his thighs of brass, His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.”
“A stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet”. It struck them on the feet. That is the Achilles heel.

Babylon, Persia and Media, Greece, Rome, and the last, America and NATO from 1776 until today. We are in this last empire, the fourth empire, still a continuation of Rome; the party is not over. All of it was “broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors”, and “the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.” That great mountain is God’s kingdom being established, and it smites this statue on the heel, on the feet: the end of this empire.
Now the interpretation. “Thou art this head of gold”: the head of gold represents Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonian empire.

“And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee”: after Babylon came Persia and Media, the silver. “And another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.” The brass empire is the Greeks.
“And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron”. Write that down: the fourth kingdom is Rome.

“The kingdom shall be divided”. Christ said a house or nation divided against itself cannot stand, and you see this last empire divided on the news. “There shall be in it of the strength of the iron”: their military. America has one of the most powerful militaries on the planet, so they still have that iron.

The toes of the feet are the EU and NATO, the Europeans, the same as the seven heads and ten horns of Revelation 17. “Partly strong”, militarily, “and partly broken”: that is the clay.

“They shall mingle themselves with the seed of men”: that melting pot of all nations is the miry clay. “But they shall not cleave one to another”: each nation looks out for its own interests, so there is no unity of all nations, which is why it is divided. Except black people: we are the only race that does not look out for our own best interest. We look out for the Chinese, the Japanese, the Palestinians, anybody else; the Japanese got reparations for World War II, and black people got a boot in the butt.

“In the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”. We are living in the days of these kings, and what you see in this truth is the beginning of God’s kingdom. That is the difference between the Israelites and the Black Panthers or any other group: you might kill millions of us, but this truth is going to continue. It is literally in the Bible, and that should solidify your faith.

“And the kingdom shall not be left to other people”: other races are not ruling in the kingdom of heaven. They will be there, but they will not rule anything; they will be our servants. Black people get offended when you bring that out, but that is what the Bible says. “It shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”, and we are consuming them with the word of God.

“The stone was cut out of the mountain without hands”: without man’s hands. The stone is Christ, and Christ is coming to destroy these empires. “The dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.”

The scholars know who the stone is striking. John Allen’s Modern Judaism (1830) records that the descendants of Esau, the sworn enemies of Jacob even to the end of the world, were at first a small nation in mount Seir, increased after Israel was destroyed by the Assyrians and Babylonians, subjugated Italy, founded Rome and the Roman empire, overturned the Jewish state when Titus destroyed the second temple, now profess the religion of Jesus of Nazareth and hold dominion over all Europe, and detain Jacob in captivity, the tribe of Judah, which is the American blacks, until Messiah son of David appears. William Smith’s Dictionary of the Bible (1890) says the rabbis read Edom as Rome, that Kimchi held Julius Caesar was an Idumean, and that the Jews believed Titus was an Edomite. The prophecies against Esau in Isaiah, Jeremiah and Obadiah have not yet received their full accomplishment; the final vengeance for the destruction of the second temple and our captivity is still waiting for the time of the Messiah. So when Christian commentary says Esau is done away with, as if the book of Obadiah were already past, these books show they are lying: Edom is still here, waiting on his judgment.

precepts.why:
What does it mean that the third kingdom, the brass, the Greeks, “shall bear rule over all the earth”? “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”. Alexander was the first over Greece; he united those Europeans, all those Edomite nations, together.

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth, And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”. That is what Daniel meant by bearing rule over all the earth. “Whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up”: this is the beginning of white supremacy, of white power in the earth. They destroyed the dark nations, and everybody had to pay the Greeks tribute.

He fell sick, of syphilis, “and parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.” His four mightiest generals, Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Seleucus and Cassander, slaughtered the other generals like Antigonus: Ptolemy took Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Cassander Macedonia, Lysimachus Thrace and Asia Minor. “They all put crowns upon themselves”, “and evils were multiplied in the earth.”

And Alexander was Esau. The Chronology of Ancient Nations (1879) traces Philip’s pedigree back through Eliphaz to Esau, Isaac and Abraham, and The Rise of Christendom (1890) says King Philip was a descendant of Esau, son of Isaac. The scholars know the Greek kingdom of Daniel 2:39 was an Edomite kingdom; it is only black people who do not know.

Who is the stone cut out of the mountain without hands? We are “built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone”. Christ is the chief cornerstone, the leader, the King. He is the stone that smites the image on its feet of iron and clay and breaks the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver and the gold to pieces.

sense.text: “What shall be the parting asunder of the times?” Meaning, when shall the end come? “Or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?”
The angel breaks the times down: “From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.” That goes back to Genesis 25:26.

“For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” Esau is the last ruler. The Israelites who say Japheth is ruling now are stupid as hell; the Bible says Esau is the end of the world, and that is what Genesis 25:26 was revealing. Jacob is the beginning of the kingdom that follows.

“The hand of man is betwixt the heel and the hand”: all the other nations are between Jacob and Esau. They are like extras in a movie. The star is Jacob, the co-star is Esau, and the Chinese, the Japanese, the East Indians and the Arabs in the middle are extras.
Daniel “wrote the dream”. A lot of you have dreams and just let them go. Write them down, because as you wake up you start to forget the details; Daniel wrote it down.
“Four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another”: different one from the other.

“The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings”. That is Babylon. “I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked”: it plucked the Assyrian empire, which it conquered. Babylon “was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it”, meaning wisdom was given unto it.

“Another beast, a second, like to a bear”: Persia and Media. “It raised up itself on one side”: it was a dual empire, and the Persians rose up greater than the Medes. “Arise, devour much flesh”: conquer.

“Another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl”: four militaries. “The beast had also four heads”: Lysimachus, Cassander, Ptolemy and Seleucus, the four generals of Alexander. “And dominion was given to it”: dominion was given to the Greeks.

Notice the fourth beast is not given an animal symbol the way Babylon was the lion with eagle’s wings, Persia and Media the bear, and the Greeks the leopard. It is Rome, “dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly”, with “great iron teeth”.

It “stamped the residue with the feet of it”, like stomping on somebody so hard your bootprint shows on his face. What they stamped on us is their philosophies and doctrines: Sunday, the days of the week, all the foolishness the white man has told us. That is them stomping on us. Rome did not play, “and it had ten horns”, the same ten horns of Revelation, what we call NATO today.

Esau even put out a picture with a made-up symbol for the fourth beast, because he knows it is the eagle and counts on black Christians not reading.

“There came up among them another little horn”: America, which came out of Britain. “Before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”: France in the French and American war, Britain in the War of Independence, and Spain in the Spanish-American War. America plucked those three up to make itself the United States.

“In this horn were eyes like the eyes of man”: great vision. The American white man created the airplane, went to the moon, made the phones and the technology, and shared his vision with his European brothers, not with Africa or Puerto Rico. “And a mouth speaking great things”: they blasphemed the Lord and said if there is a God, he is a white man.

precepts.why: To explain the three ribs in the bear’s mouth, start at Isaiah 45:1: “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut”. God chose Cyrus the Persian, the bear of Daniel 7:5, to release the Israelites, and held his right hand to subdue nations before him.

Then what did Cyrus, what did Persia, do? “The labour of Egypt”, that is the first rib, “and merchandise of Ethiopia”, the second rib, “and of the Sabeans”, which is Somalia, the third rib, “men of stature”, tall men, “shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else”.

When the Most High told Cyrus to release his people from captivity, he made him ruler over many nations, and Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans are the three ribs in the mouth of the bear of Daniel 7:5: “Arise, devour much flesh.”

Daniel was not shown the animal symbol of the fourth beast; it was shown to Ezra: “This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.”

That is why precept must be upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little; if you do not read the Bible that way you will be confused. The fourth beast of Daniel 7:7 is the eagle, Rome.

The mouth speaking great things: “And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High”. They wear us out in slavery.

“And think to change times and laws”: daylight saving time, the year beginning in the dead of winter, same-sex laws, if it feels good do it, and the Sabbath moved from the seventh day to the first day of the week. “And they shall be given into his hand”: the Israelites are given into this man’s hand “until a time and times and the dividing of time.” Time is one, times is two, and the dividing of time a half: three and a half, 350 years.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”. This is not a physical fight. That is why we do not say Trump is the last one: when he goes, somebody else takes his seat and the same spirit jumps on him, the way a new man took Fauci’s spot.

“Against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world”: governments, with a hierarchy among them, America at the pinnacle followed by Britain, France and Germany. “Against spiritual wickedness in high places”: the deep state and the shadow government, the career bureaucrats, the CIA, the FBI and the military officials who keep their own agenda regardless of who is elected. The president is a figurehead, a manager; your vote does not change a thing. When the man who runs the electric grid said he would turn out the lights if Trump touched Canada, Trump had to back off. Republicans and Democrats are two horns on the same beast, good cop and bad cop with the same agenda: to lock you up and overthrow your footsteps.

sense.text: Daniel saw a ram and a goat going at it. “The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.” “The rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king”: Alexander the Greek, whom we read about in 1 Maccabees 1:1.

“Four stood up for it”: the four generals. “But not in his power”: Alexander had united the Europeans, all white folks, but his four generals were at each other’s throats and did not have his charisma.

“In the latter time of their kingdom” is this time we are in now. “When the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences”. There are groups among them that know who the 12 tribes are and what is going to happen.

How will anybody know the transgressors have come to the full? The churches are not bringing out the transgressions; church makes you think things are paradise. The Israelites are the ones bringing out the transgressions of this system, so that is where they are watching, to measure their time.

“His power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: Satan gave him his power. “He shall destroy wonderfully”: you are seeing an inkling of it, and it is only going to escalate. He “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” That is us; they have not finished with the 12 tribes yet.

“Through his policy”, his politics, “he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”, “and by peace shall destroy many”. Trump has a Board of Peace that charges nations a billion dollars for a seat; it was pitched for rebuilding Gaza and has grown into an alternative to the UN. Jared Kushner, Amalek, sits on it with Marco Rubio, Steve Witkoff and Tony Blair; they will use it to keep taking land, and when they kill people there will be nowhere to complain, because they run it. The UN has no power except over dark nations, and it sits on stolen land while the Native Americans whose land it is have no seat. Trump is a diversion and a figurehead; the shadow government is running it.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: that is Christ. “But he shall be broken without hand.” That is what we read in Daniel 2: this extension of ancient Rome is going to fall. The great stone shall smash the heel, for Esau is the end of the world.

precepts.why:
He understands dark sentences, and he knows the time: “Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” The heavens are the sovereign nations, America the so-called free world, France, Germany and Britain, and their people dwell in them. “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth”, the other nations, “and of the sea”, the islands like Jamaica and Haiti.

“For the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” How does he know? He examines the scriptures and he examines the 12 tribes of Israel, their level of understanding, and bases his time on us. That is why, after YouTube shut Israelite videos down for a year, they let them back on: they were running blind in the dark.

You see what Israel is doing to the Palestinians and what Trump has ICE doing. It is going to get worse. Some of you can play games, but the rest of us, prepare yourselves.

“His power shall be mighty, but not by his own power.” The beast “was like unto a leopard”, elements of the Greeks, “and his feet were as the feet of a bear”, elements of Persia and Media, “and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”, elements of ancient Babylon. “And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.”

That dragon is Satan. This man does not work on his own; he deals with spirits. China made firecrackers, and a spirit told Esau to put them together into a bomb, to put the powder in a metal casing and shoot his enemies at a distance, to build a propulsion unit for the moon and a suit to breathe in. People ask how the white man figured all this out: Satan. The dragon gave him his power.

“By peace shall destroy many.” “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.” Peace and safety is that Board of Peace, and they shall not escape.

sense.text: “The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.” Everything you read about in Genesis 1, you can see the handiwork of the Most High God.

“Day unto day uttereth speech”: God’s speech, the teachings of the Bible. “And night unto night sheweth knowledge.” You might think the speech and knowledge are the sun, moon and stars; no, it is the teachers. The brothers out teaching day by day and night by night, bringing out the knowledge of the Holy Bible.
“There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.” We are hearing the gospel taught in all languages now.

“Their line is gone out through all the earth”: their line of teaching, which is repentance for the 12 tribes of Israel in the name of our King whom the world calls Jesus the Christ, “and their words to the end of the world.”

“In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun”. Another word for tabernacle is sanctuary, and the sun represents wisdom, the word of God. That is why we set up tabernacles, sanctuaries, in every country and state we go to: we are fulfilling prophecy.

“As a bridegroom coming out of his chamber”: the way a man is excited about to be married, that is how the teachers teach the word of God. If you are boring, brother, sit yourself down; you just want to be seen on video. You have to be a lively stone, as Christ was the living stone. “And rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race”: the teachers take off like a strong man running to win.
“His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it”: that is Christ. “And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof”: nothing is hid from the heat of God’s word.

Now it breaks down what the speech, the language and the knowledge are. “The law of the Lord is perfect”. People always look for problems in the Bible, how many horses Solomon had in one chapter and another; who cares? The law is perfect: no other gods, no images to bow down to, do not take the name of the Lord in vain, remember the Sabbath, honor your father and mother, do not kill, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not covet. That is perfect.

The law of the Lord converts the soul, and it is the only thing that can. “The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.” All of us came into the truth simple; we did not know a thing.
“The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.”

precepts.why:
How do we know Psalm 19 is talking about teaching? Paul broke it down so we do not have to guess: “But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.” Paul is quoting Psalm 19, and their sound is the sound of teaching.

“How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?” You need a preacher to hear this gospel. “And how shall they preach, except they be sent?” “How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace”. That is why we tell you, brothers, prepare yourselves to be sent.

“Lord, who hath believed our report?” The report is the Bible, the scriptures the prophets are preaching. “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.” That is how you increase your faith: addict yourself to hearing the teaching over and over, because however old you are, that is how many years of brainwashing you must undo. Once a week will not undo it; it has to be daily, four chapters a day and more.

And whose sound is going throughout all the earth? Not the doctrines of having babies everywhere, of raping women and keeping concubines, of John the Baptist being a wicked Israelite, or of going back under the old covenant of animal sacrifice. Those teachings are not going throughout all the earth. We give all praise to the Lord for favoring us.

sense.text: “To set up on high those that be low”: that is us. We are low right now, but he is going to set us up on high. “That those which mourn may be exalted to safety”: our people shall be exalted to safety and comfort, out of this cruel world.

“He disappointeth the devices of the crafty”: the crafty is this white man, and Job prophetically says God will disappoint him, “so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.” Look at the back of the dollar bill: Annuit Coeptis, our enterprise succeeds, and Novus Ordo Seclorum, a new world order. The pyramid is not finished; they have not completed what they want to do, which is to wipe us out.

“He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.” To be froward is to be against God in your mind, and carried headlong is to trip and crack your head open. “They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.”
“But he saveth the poor from the sword”, “So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.”

“Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth”. We get corrected all the time, and we might not be happy going through it, but it says happy is the man God corrects. “Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty”.
“For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.” He will make us whole again.
“He shall deliver thee in six troubles”: six troubles means six trumps. “Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.” By the seventh trump no evil shall touch us; it is going to be kingdom time.

“In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.” “Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue”: nobody is going to utter a word against the 12 tribes of Israel; fix your lips to call us something, and it is off with your head.

“Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.” He is telling us not to be afraid, because destruction is going to come, even though some of you believe nothing could ever happen in America. The angels will protect the brothers and sisters alive at that time.
“At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh”. We are going to laugh at that thing. “The beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.”
“Thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.” We will not sin.

“Thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth”: our children are going to grow up quickly. “Like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season”: as a shock of corn comes back over and over, Israel is going to have a long, long life. That is why he calls it forever, eternal.

precepts.why:
It goes with this. “Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth”. The arrogancy is the foolishness, the wisdom of this world; pastor, do not let it come out of your mouth. “For the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.” He judges us on what we do, not our thoughts, though you should control those too.

“The Lord killeth, and maketh alive”, “The Lord maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.” That is what we were reading in Job 5:11: we are low, but we are going to be exalted.

“He raiseth up the poor out of the dust”. The dust is a low state of confusion, and the poor are the poor in spirit. “And lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill”: we are the beggar, begging for reparations, section 8 and a job. Whatever kind of house you have, compared to where we came from it is a dunghill. “To set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory”: he is going to make us inherit the throne of glory.

Why despise not the chastening? “We glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience”. There is a purpose behind tribulation. Patience teaches experience, “and experience, hope: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts”. We understand why God allows us to go through tribulation: he is teaching us something, even if we do not understand it while we are in it.

“For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.” This is why we go through things we do not like at the moment. If you are in this truth, expect to be scourged. “If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons”.

“But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.” Nobody wants to be a bastard. That is why happy is the man whom God corrects.

He makes us sore: “Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters”. That is us; we have forsaken the Lord and gone away backward from his laws. “Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more”.

“From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up”. Isaiah 1:4-6 is speaking of the nation of Israel, and so is Job. Job was real, but his life represents us: he lost everything, even his health from the top of his head to the sole of his foot. God has made us sore, and he will bind us up and make us whole.

“In seven there shall no evil touch thee.” “And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.” Six troubles are six trumps, and at the seventh trump it is the kingdom, and no evil shall touch us.

“And shalt not sin.” “Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting”. Our people shall all be righteous and inherit the land forever; we are the branch of God’s planting.

“A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.” We are going to have a whole lot of children; he will bring certain spirits back quickly through marriage and childbearing.

sense.text: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. Write that down.
“His truth shall be thy shield and buckler”: his law shall be thy shield and buckler.
“Nor for the arrow that flieth by day”: missiles. “Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday”: it is telling you the time; the destruction will be at noonday.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” We can only see it in little movies now. “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked”: you will be delivered while the enemies are being put to death.
We will see that only because we made the Lord our refuge and the Most High our habitation. “There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.”

“For he shall give his angels charge over thee”. “They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.” There is going to be so much destruction that the angels will make sure we are not hurt.
“Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder”: the nations. “The young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet”: we are going to trample these nations.

“Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him”: because the believer has set his love upon the Lord. “I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.” “And shew him my salvation.”

precepts.why: “The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.” The secrets of God are his word, so the secret place of the Most High is the Bible. Dwell in it and you abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

When that destruction comes: “And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.”

“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds”. That is what Psalm 91:12 means: the angels bear us up in their hands lest we dash our foot against a stone. We are delivered while we see with our eyes the reward of the wicked.

sense.text: “The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters”. Many times you read precepts about great waters, and they are talking about nations. “But God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off”.

“And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not.” That is how quickly the Lord is going to do away with the wicked. “This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.” This is the reward of them that robbed us.
“The triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment”. It seems like a long time, but the Bible says the triumphing of the wicked is short.

In case you did not know who this wicked man and hypocrite is: “Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds”. Who is doing space travel and flying the planes? The white man, who came up with that technology. “Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung”, like his own shit. “They which have seen him shall say, Where is he?” Where is the white man? Where is Esau? He will be gone like that.

“He shall fly away as a dream”, like waking up out of a bad dream, “he shall be chased away as a vision of the night”: a vision of the night is a nightmare. “The eye also which saw him shall see him no more”.
“His hands shall restore their goods.” That is why we are not worried about reparations: the Bible already prophesied that they are going to restore everything they took from us and more.
“His bones are full of the sin of his youth”: from the time of Cain. You could go back to 1776, but this goes all the way back to Cain and what he did.

“Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue”. Wickedness is sweet in this white man’s mouth; he showed President Obama and Michelle as monkeys, and he is so proud he will not even apologize, and even if he did, never believe his apology.

Verse 13 is heavy: “Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth”. He spared his wickedness for the past 60 years, from civil rights around 1965 until now, and we had all that time to get the 12 tribes organized and squandered it. He never forsook it; he kept it in his mouth. Now the civil liberties are going out the window, he is mocking black people and getting rid of Black History Month, and he has pulled the mask off to show you he is the devil. The Most High is allowing it because we have been playing games.

“His meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him”: poison, his philosophies. “He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again”: whatever he stole, he shall vomit it up.
“He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.” Verse 17 is talking about the kingdom. He will not rule in it; he will be a servant there, and he will not be happy.

“That which he laboured for shall he restore”, “according to his substance shall the restitution be”. Another word for restitution is reparations. “And he shall not rejoice therein”: he is not going to be happy about a thing, and we are going to be happy.

Verse 19 tells why: “Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor”, that is us, “because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not.” He took homes and houses he did not build; black people built the White House.

“There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods”: he will have nothing, because he stole everything he has. “In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits”: he is going to catch hell. “Every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.”

“When he is about to fill his belly”, meaning when he shall say peace and safety, “God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him”: then there shall be sudden destruction, and it comes “while he is eating.”

“He shall flee from the iron weapon”: the missile, the intercontinental ballistic missile, is the iron weapon the Bible is prophesying. “And the bow of steel shall strike him through.” “It is drawn, and cometh out of the body”: it comes out of the earth. “Terrors are upon him.”

The Most High caused him to build the very weapon that will end this whole thing. Even the scientist who knows from the Bible that they will do it to themselves builds it anyway; that is where the power really is.

“All darkness shall be hid in his secret places”: whatever bunker they try to get into will do them no good. “A fire not blown shall consume him”: nuclear fire, which you do not have to blow on for it to spread. “It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”: whoever is left in the good old USA.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.” “His goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath. This is the portion of a wicked man from God”. Edom’s Achilles heel: he is over.
